look_here_first: Opposite leaves on creeping mudflat stems, but unlike L. repens the tiny axillary flowers generally lack petals; check green longitudinal bands on short capsule.

morphology_keys.habit: Creeping/decumbent perennial of wet mud and shallow water; roots at nodes.
morphology_keys.leaves: Opposite, small elliptic to obovate, generally entire.
morphology_keys.flower: Tiny axillary flowers, four sepals but normally NO petals; four stamens.
morphology_keys.fruit: Very short thin-walled capsule; often shows darker or greener lengthwise bands in capsule wall.
best_field_traits: Opposite leaves on creeping mudflat stems, but unlike L. repens the tiny axillary flowers generally lack petals; check green longitudinal bands on short capsule.

comparisons.key_distinctions: Critical L. repens look-alike: palustris lacks true yellow petals while repens bears tiny yellow petals; capsule wall green striping often supports palustris; sterile mats can remain indeterminate.
